method.cross: KK: ideology_0 > 0; RTE: ideology_0 < 0. Zero and missing scores are not cross-ideology.
method.denominator: All scored arrivals, including zero. Shares are weighted by relationships, not averages of daily percentages.
method.baseline: The complete 28 UTC days immediately before each 7-day window.
method.ranking: Observed cross arrivals minus window scored arrivals × prior-28-day cross share. At least 7,000 window scored and 1,000 baseline scored; candidate starts separated by at least 28 days.
method.sensitivity: Also count KK scores >= +0.5 and RTE scores <= -0.5, using the same all-scored denominator.
method.boundary: Discovery windows exclude the final observation day, 26 May 2023. Daily boundary counts remain in the audit.
method.interpretation: Descriptive, exploratory timing. Current account-level estimates do not identify ideology at follow time, switching, endorsement, or event effects. Event links were researched after the numerical scan.
